articles.title: VPN disconnects with auth_timeout
articles.symptoms: VPN connection drops repeatedly; client log shows auth_timeout.
articles.cause: VPN clients older than 5.0 use a deprecated auth handshake that times out against current gateways.
resolution_steps: Confirm the VPN gateway is healthy.
Check the installed VPN client version.
If below 5.0, update the VPN client to the latest version (5.2) from the Software Center.
Reconnect and confirm the connection is stable.

articles.title: Account locked after failed sign-in attempts
articles.symptoms: User cannot sign in; account shows as locked.
articles.cause: 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts trigger an automatic 30 minute lockout.
resolution_steps: Confirm the account is locked and how many failed attempts were recorded.
Tell the user the account unlocks automatically after 30 minutes.
Advise the user to check saved credentials on phones/other devices that may be retrying.
If urgent, the user can contact the Service Desk by phone for identity-verified unlock.

articles.title: Printer shows offline
articles.symptoms: Printer appears offline in the print dialog.
articles.cause: Stale print queue or printer lost network connection.
resolution_steps: Re-add the printer from the self-service portal.
